meta.name: popular-support-analysis
meta.description: Use when analyzing rebellion risk or diagnosing why uprisings succeed or fail. Applies the principle 安民可与行义而危民易与为非 to assess popular contentment vs. endangerment using economic, legal, and safety indicators. References Chen She's rebellion.

copy.tagline: 评估民众满意度与叛乱风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析社会动荡风险或历史叛乱案例。
copy.tagline_en: Assess popular contentment and rebellion risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze social unrest risk or historical rebellion cases.

howto.what: Claude 会依据“安民可与行义，而危民易与为非”原则，通过经济、法律、安全等指标评估民众是“安”还是“危”，并据此分析叛乱风险或起义成败的原因。
howto.when: 当你分析叛乱风险、诊断起义成功或失败的原因时触发。

say.text: 评估当前社会的民意状况是安还是危？
say.note: Claude 会分析关键指标并给出风险等级。

say.text: 分析陈胜起义成功的原因。
say.note: Claude 会引用“危民易与为非”来解释。

say.text: 判断这个国家的叛乱风险高不高？
say.note: Claude 会使用经济、法律、安全指标评估。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses popular contentment vs. endangerment using economic, legal, and safety indicators, then analyzes rebellion risk or why uprisings succeed/fail, based on the principle that contented people support righteous action while endangered people are easily led to rebellion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when analyzing rebellion risk or diagnosing why uprisings succeed or fail.

say_en.text: Assess whether the public is content or endangered now.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate indicators and give risk level.

say_en.text: Why did Chen She's rebellion succeed?
say_en.note: Claude will explain using the principle of endangered people.

say_en.text: What is the rebellion risk in this country?
say_en.note: Claude will use economic, legal, safety indicators.
